newGarmentWeightMethod: regional analytic blend on original joint indices; not original weights
limitations: Single connected garment is a new lofted topology; original garment meshes remain only as unreferenced source buffers, not drawn.
Original neck/hands overlap the garment caps; posed clipping/self-intersection and silhouette quality not visually checked.
Profile dimensions are artistic estimates informed by V3 and sprite; native S2 rendering unperformed.
